details:
This update for ImageMagick fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-86420: Denial of Service due to memory budget exhaustion (bsc#1279696).
- CVE-2026-86421: Denial of Service via memory leak in MSL decoder (bsc#1279711).
- CVE-2026-86423: Denial of service via heap-use-after-free in PerlMagick's GetList method (bsc#1279794).
- CVE-2026-86425: Denial of Service due to heap-use-after-free vulnerability (bsc#1279797).
- CVE-2026-93586: use-after-free in the `ImagesToBlob` method can lead to a process crash (bsc#1281912).
- CVE-2026-93587: policy bypass in the PCD, CUBE and HALD coders can lead to extra memory allocation and a denial of
  service (bsc#1281909).
- CVE-2026-93588: NULL pointer dereference in the PNM coder can lead to a denial of service (bsc#1281910).
- CVE-2026-93589: division-by-zero flaw in the FLIF encoder can lead to a denial of service (bsc#1281911).
- CVE-2026-93590: failure to perform policy checks during buffer allocation for image pixels in the UHDR encoder can
  lead to denial of service (bsc#1281913).
- CVE-2026-105083: security policy not applied when a user changes the DOCTYPE in the `policy.xml` file to something
  else that is valid xml (bsc#1284217).
- CVE-2026-106564: a crafted EXR image can cause the EXR decoder to write beyond a heap buffer, causing the process to
  crash (bsc#1284661).
- CVE-2026-106565: a missing end-of-file check while reading bzip2-compressed image data can cause an infinite loop
  (bsc#1284662).
- CVE-2026-106566: delegate symlink cleanup does not check the MAGICK_SHRED_PASSES environment variable, allowing a
  local privileged workflow to overwrite a file with random data (bsc#1284663).
- CVE-2026-106567: a crafted PSD file can trigger an integer-conversion error in the PSD decoder, causing an infinite
  loop and DoS (bsc#1284664).
- CVE-2026-106568: a crafted XMP profile embedded in an image can cause the profile parser to enter an infinite loop
  (bsc#1284665).
- CVE-2026-106570: an unauthenticated adjacent-network client can repeatedly connect to the distributed pixel cache
  server and exhaust its available connections, causing a DoS (bsc#1284667).
- CVE-2026-106571: a crafted local call to the GetVirtualPixels API can trigger an integer calculation error and write
  beyond a heap buffer, crashing the server process (bsc#1284668).
- CVE-2026-106572: a missing recursion-depth check in the CALS decoder allows a crafted CALS image to exhaust the call
  stack and terminate the process (bsc#1284669).
- CVE-2026-106573: a missing limit check in the MVG decoder allows a crafted MVG image to trigger an excessively long-
  running operation (bsc#1284671).
- CVE-2026-106574: a client connected to the distributed pixel cache server can send crafted pixel data that triggers a
  heap buffer overwrite and crash the server (bsc#1284672).
- CVE-2026-106575: a crafted Magick script can cause an opened file pointer to remain unclosed, allowing repeated
  processing to exhaust available file descriptors (bsc#1284673).
- CVE-2026-106576: a crafted XMP profile can trigger excessive work while the parser determines a rational value's
  numerator and denominator, causing a DoS (bsc#1284674).
- CVE-2026-106577: unescaped or untrimmed values can inject code into output generated by PostScript coders
  (bsc#1284675).
- CVE-2026-106578: a crafted image can cause an invalid memory free in the MVG decoder and crash the process
  (bsc#1284677).
- CVE-2026-106579: a crafted image can bypass an ImageMagick security policy that uses coder as its domain, potentially
  allowing data prohibited by the policy to be read (bsc#1284678).
- CVE-2026-107208: a crafted XMP profile can reach a recursion limit that is handled as a fatal condition instead of an
  ordinary exception, terminating the image-processing process (bsc#1284681).
- CVE-2026-107209: when ImageMagick is built without Cairo support, a crafted RSVG image that reaches a resource limit
  can cause a crash (bsc#1284682).
- CVE-2026-107210: a crafted highly compressed MAT image can make the MAT decoder create temporary files larger than the
  configured security-policy limit (bsc#1284683).
